name: grader-web-dispatch
title: Tell the web repo to rebuild when a new grader is published
issue: User request 2026-10-10. The web app now pulls the published browser grader at build time (web item published-grader #71) and must be rebuilt whenever a NEW grader version is published. PLAN: In .github/workflows/publish-content.yml, after the grader publish step and only when a grader version was actually bumped (the byte-change gate from PR #33; a content-only publish sends nothing), send a repository_dispatch to EpicNicks/Qamooscheh-Web with event_type grader-published and client_payload {language, variant: browser, version, manifestSha256}. Use the gh CLI or the REST API with a token read from a repository secret named WEB_REPO_DISPATCH_TOKEN (fine-grained token, contents/actions write on the web repo only); never print it, never put it on a command line in logs; if the secret is missing the step must warn and skip, not fail the publish. Document the secret and the event in tools/README.md and the workflow header. Do not change anything else. The user must create the secret; say so in the PR body.
acceptance: Dispatch sent only when a grader version bumped, payload carries language/variant/version/sha
Missing secret warns and skips without failing the publish
gate: plan approved by the user 2026-10-10 (explicit request)
